parts.script:
Sarah: Hey Tom, have you thought about what we should do this weekend?  
Tom: I was thinking we could explore that new hiking trail outside of town.  
Sarah: Oh, the one by the lake? I heard it has some amazing views!  
Tom: Exactly! We could pack some lunch and make a day out of it.  
Sarah: Sounds great! Do you have any specific time in mind?  
Tom: I was thinking of leaving early, maybe around 7 AM, to avoid the heat later in the day.  
Sarah: Good idea. Should we invite Rachel? She might enjoy the hike.  
Tom: Definitely! I’ll text her later. What should we take for lunch?  
Sarah: How about sandwiches and some fruit? We can also bring water bottles.  
Tom: Perfect! I’ll handle the sandwiches. Do you want to bring the fruit?  
Sarah: Sure! I’ll also pack some snacks just in case.  
Tom: Awesome. I’m really looking forward to it!  
Sarah: Me too! It’s been ages since we went hiking together.
